raw:
Agent Name: DataExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly treated the set of recipients as if it were the set of givers. By computing “non_giver = all_employees - recipients,” they actually identified who did not receive a gift (the person whose interests didn’t match any listed gift) rather than who failed to give one. This logical error led to the wrong conclusion (Rebecca) as the non-giver. Additionally, they proceeded despite the “Gift Assignments” section being empty, so there was no basis to map recipients back to givers.
